name: Xero
description: Invoices, payments and credit notes in Xero for your orders

images.title: Paid orders, invoiced in Xero
images.description: An invoice is created in Xero when an order is paid, and a credit note when it is refunded.

images.title: Invoices that arrive as paid
images.description: Each payment is recorded on the Xero account you name, with the Xero tax rate that matches the tax your store charged.

images.title: Nothing lost quietly
images.description: What Xero refuses is listed with the reason. Correct the cause and retry, one by one or all at once.

images.title: Set up in minutes
images.description: Enter your Xero custom connection and test it. It names your organisation and what the settings still need.
